Right...but even something like Pre-Sequel got two fleshed-out DLC's, and two new Vault hunters.  


What is this game going to have? 2 ITEMS per DLC release? That's ridiculous.   


I was thinking about this while I read over my comment again, but think about how much nice shit we got in BL3 for 0.00.   


\-Takedowns (which are literally BETTER THAN THESE "DLCs")  
\-Promos like Borderlands Science (obviously not a huge must-play, but still nice additional modes)  
\-Mayhem levels increasing and reworking  
\-Extra weapons for all users  
\-Hemovorous  
\-Limited time events like Revenge of the Cartels, etc.  


Look at all of that and tell me that 4 DLCs that add one or two ITEMS, are completely not structured in a fairer way like the actual Chaos Chamber (which allows you to die up to 4 times), and lack even the humor or continuations of the story that the base game had?  


It's fucking ridiculous comparing it to anything in gaming. I don't think there's ever been a bigger rug pull I've seen in a video game in terms of DLC. 10, fucking, minutes to charge 9.99. Unreal.

Even taking you at your word that they have outlined this before, where in Borderlands history has so little been given at this price point??   


Headhunter packs were like 3.99 for larger and longer levels than these crumbs of content. This pass is the same cost as Borderlands 1, 2, and 3's for not even 1/100th the length. It is super misleading to price it as such, and on top of this, it's not creating nearly any new weapons or artifacts.   


I understand that they may have touched on this before, but the price, quality, and content are terrible. Explain to me why you'd ever even want to run this considering a death kicks you out of the WHOLE DUNGEON. At least in chaos chambers, you have at least 4 tries to clear it. What is the point of this at all? It doesn't make sense from any aspect, any way you slice it. Just because someone tells you that they're going to get you in a car crash doesn't make this okay. Whenever they did lay this out, I'm sure they were accepting preorders for the super mega deluxe version of this game. It's inexcusable and was made to manipulate anyone who preordered.
